scope: Spectra Gami Spectra USDC MetaVault on Base: exact user-facing MetaVaultWrapper async request, decrease, deposit-share claim and redemption-asset claim. No APWine legacy, Safe/Zodiac executors, generic Spectra router, bridge, pool or curator action.

lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Official current Spectra app exposes Gami Spectra USDC with deposit UI, VISIBLE server-rendered status and ongoing settlement epochs. Official current MetaVault architecture and guide describe this ERC7540 user-wrapper product, distinct from APWine legacy. Reviewed official sources provide no retirement/wind-down notice for this market. App displayed approximately $3.0M market TVL; this is a product-specific UI snapshot, not independently attested vault balance or DAU. No high-DAU or protocol-wide TVL claim is made.

abiEvidence.evidence: Full applicable implementation ABI and source obtained from the exact deployed implementation through Sourcify v2, resolved from exact proxy. Match labels are recorded verbatim. No generic ERC4626 ABI substitution and no fresh RPC identity/execution assertion.
